drivers.explanation: Active patients fell 44.6% in 90 days, from 900 to 499, and the program is at 55.4% of its enrollment forecast, so the account is shrinking well below contracted volume.
The brand's field team is reportedly focused elsewhere and won't commit to a review, which suggests the manufacturer may be deprioritizing this program and could downsize at renewal.
Portal engagement has halved and refill adherence is only 51.3%, so patients and the brand team are both disengaging from the program.

tool_input.next_step: Ask Hannah to book an executive-sponsor review this week, framed around the 44.6% active-patient drop, and come with a plan to recover new starts and refill adherence.
